reader.requirement: At --std 85 the program-name in END PROGRAM must be a 1985 user-defined word: at most 30 characters from A-Z, 0-9 and hyphen, no hyphen first or last, at least one letter, not a 1985 reserved word, no underscore and no literal; lowercase is equivalent to uppercase.

edition-consulted.switches: word length ceiling 30 at 85, 31 at 2002/2014, 63 at 2023
underscore and extended letters gated to 2002
the reserved-word set per edition (MOVE refused; CONSTANT a user word at 85)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: a 31- to 63-character name and an underscore are legal at 2023 and refused at 85; words reserved only from 2002 (CONSTANT) are legal names at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover a name mismatch and END FUNCTION at 85; not length, reserved words, hyphen placement, digits-only names, underscore or literals

probes.printed: RAN ABCDEFGH (30-character name, END PROGRAM written in lowercase)
COBOL1567 31 characters, exceeding the 30-character maximum for COBOL-85; COBOL2793 mismatch
COBOL1567 (31 characters, reported once for the word)
COBOL0901 'MOVE' is a reserved word in COBOL-85
COBOL2773 the hyphen as its last character
COBOL5506 the integer literal 12345 is not expected here
COBOL5506 the alphanumeric literal is not expected here
COBOL0900 the underscore in a COBOL word requires COBOL-2002 (+COBOL2793)

probes.expected: accepted: CONSTANT is not a 1985 reserved word
accepted: a digit-first word with a letter

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.2.4.3 SR1  (║2.4.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.1  (4.2.2.1 COBOL Words)  the text is in the clause

reader.notes: endProgramHeader takes programName (cobolWord | reservedGatedWord), so literals and integers fail to parse; the cobolWord funnel applies the 1985 length ceiling, character set and reserved-word set to the end marker's name like any other user word.

refuter.evidence: At --std 85: ealter.cob (ALTER, reserved in 1985 and not in 2002/2023) COBOL0901 'ALTER is a reserved word in COBOL-85'; eevery.cob (END PROGRAM EVERY, a 1985-only reserved word) COBOL0901 at the end marker plus COBOL2793; ehyfirst.cob (END PROGRAM -HYF) COBOL2773 refused; ecase.cob (PROGRAM-ID in mixed case, END PROGRAM in upper case) EXIT 0 'RAN CASE'; econt.cob (end marker's program-name continued across lines with an indicator-area hyphen) EXIT 0 'RAN CONT'. The cobolWord funnel applies the per-edition reserved set (ReservedWords.RejectsAt, already listed by the reader) to the end marker. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.2.4.3 SR1  (║2.4.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR1'.
